about_short_description.short_description: Eskan Bank is a financial institution that provides lending, mortgages, loans, electronic fund transfer and online banking services.

product.name: Social Housing Finance (Tas’heel and Tas’heel+)
product.description: Subsidized housing finance for eligible Bahraini citizens to purchase, build, or obtain a family home, with repayment terms of up to 30 years.

product.name: Renovation Financing
product.description: Housing finance for eligible Bahraini households to renovate an existing home, with repayment terms of up to 15 years and separate eligibility requirements.

product.name: Joint Collateral Scheme
product.description: A joint-mortgage arrangement that lets eligible social housing beneficiaries obtain additional financing from participating Islamic or conventional banks using the same property collateral.

product.name: Mazaya Housing Finance
product.description: A named Eskan Bank housing-finance program listed within the bank’s retail housing-finance portfolio for eligible Bahraini customers.

product.name: Housing Services
product.description: Housing-related services covering unit ownership and access to residential housing plots offered through Eskan Bank and associated government housing programs.

product.name: Eskan Online
product.description: An online banking and customer-service platform that provides digital access to selected Eskan Bank services and housing-finance information.
